title: XGenAct: Geometry-Enhanced World Action Models through Cross-Task Generation
title_zh: XGenAct:几何增强的世界动作模型通过跨任务生成

paragraphs.en: World action models (WAMs) have advanced robot control by predicting how observations and actions evolve over time. Despite this progress, RGB and action based future prediction does not explicitly address the spatial understanding needed for robot manipulation. Existing efforts often add a limited set of spatial prediction tasks through specialized heads or branches, leaving both the range of spatial supervision and the model architecture fragmented. We introduce XGenAct, a world action model that represents RGB observations, robot actions, metric depth, surface normals, and functional role segmentation as RGB videos through deterministic codecs. By sampling perception and action tasks during training, XGenAct uses one video diffusion transformer and one objective to learn temporal prediction across these spaces without modality specific learned heads. On held out RLBench tasks, structured perception training improves average closed loop success over RGB only training, and XGenAct achieves 52% success in the five task external comparison, versus 26% for the strongest evaluated baselines. It also predicts future depth and segmentation more accurately than the evaluated pipelines that generate RGB first and then apply a frozen perception expert.
paragraphs.zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过预测观察结果与动作随时间的演变方式，推动了机器人控制的进步。 尽管取得了这些进展，基于RGB和动作的未来预测方法并未明确解决机器人操作所需的空间理解问题。 现有的研究通常通过专门的头或分支添加有限数量的空间预测任务，导致空间监督的范围和模型架构都显得支离破碎。 我们提出了XGenAct，一种世界动作模型，它通过确定性编码器将RGB观察结果、机器人动作、度量深度、表面法线和功能角色分割表示为RGB视频。 通过在训练期间对感知和动作任务进行采样，XGenAct使用一个视频扩散变换器和一个目标函数，无需模态特定的学习头即可跨这些空间学习时间预测。 在预留的RLBench任务上，结构化感知训练提升了仅基于RGB训练的闭环成功率，而XGenAct在五个外部任务的比较中实现了52%的成功率，远高于评估中最强基线方法的26%。 它预测未来深度和分割结果的准确性也高于那些先生成RGB再应用冻结感知专家的评估流程。

paragraphs.en: World action models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for generative robot control by jointly predicting future RGB videos and robot actions ( Ye et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Zhen et al., 2026 ) . Compared with vision language action models that directly predict actions, WAMs use video generation to explicitly model how a scene evolves over time. This generative objective provides dense supervision for visual dynamics and temporal context, which can in turn improve action prediction. WAMs therefore offer a direct way to address the temporal reasoning required for robot control. However, their progress has been primarily temporal rather than spatial. Robots operate in a three dimensional world that evolves over time, while most WAMs represent the predicted world only as two dimensional RGB video. Although RGB observations contain implicit geometric cues, appearance prediction alone does not explicitly capture metric depth, surface orientation, or other spatial structures required for physical interaction. This limited spatial understanding remains a major bottleneck to further improving WAMs.
paragraphs.zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）已成为生成式机器人控制的一种有前景的范式，它通过联合预测未来的 RGB 视频和机器人动作来实现（Ye et al., 2026；Zhu et al., 2025；Zhen et al., 2026）。 与直接预测动作的视觉-语言-动作模型相比，WAMs 利用视频生成来显式建模场景随时间的演变过程。 这种生成目标为视觉动态和时序上下文提供了密集的监督信号，从而反过来可以改进动作预测。 因此，WAMs 为应对机器人控制所需的时间推理问题提供了一种直接的方法。 然而，它们的进展主要集中于时间维度，而非空间维度。 机器人在一个随时间演变的三维世界中运行，而大多数 WAMs 仅将预测的世界表示为二维 RGB 视频。 尽管 RGB 观测数据包含隐式的几何线索，但仅靠外观预测无法显式捕捉物理交互所需的度量深度、表面朝向或其他空间结构。 这种有限的空间理解能力仍然是进一步改进 WAMs 的主要瓶颈。

paragraphs.en: Recent work has begun to address this limitation by introducing spatial information into WAMs. One possible direction is to predict explicit three dimensional or four dimensional representations, such as point clouds or point trajectories. ( Zhen et al., 2025 ; Dharmarajan et al., 2025 ) While these representations provide rich geometric structure, incorporating dense reconstruction directly into a generative control model requires additional representations and decoding procedures, making efficient joint prediction with robot actions nontrivial. A more practical alternative is to supervise spatial understanding through image aligned signals, including depth, optical flow, geometric features, and semantic maps. Several recent WAMs have adopted this strategy to enrich RGB based future prediction ( Ma et al., 2026 ; Yuan et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) . However, these spatial signals are typically introduced through auxiliary prediction heads, gated residual modules, or modality specific branches, each with its own representation and training objective. Their coverage also remains fragmented. Depth receives the most attention, while few methods incorporate complementary information such as surface orientation and task dependent functional regions within a single model. We argue that spatial supervision should not remain an auxiliary component attached to an RGB based WAM. Instead, multiple geometric and semantic prediction tasks should be expressed within the same generative space used to model observations and actions, allowing structured spatial knowledge to directly shape the shared action generator.

paragraphs.en: Inspired by ActionImages Zhen et al. (2026) , which represents 7 DoF robot actions as multiview RGB videos, we consider image space as a common interface for both perception and control. This representation is particularly suitable for structured visual signals because metric depth, surface normals, and segmentation can also be expressed as decodable RGB images ( Gabeur et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . Based on this insight, we introduce XGenAct , a geometry enhanced world action model that represents RGB observations, metric depth, surface normals, functional role segmentation, and 7 DoF robot actions as RGB videos through deterministic codecs. Every stream is encoded by the same frozen video VAE into a shared latent space. During training, each sample selects a perception action template that pairs one perception stream with the action stream, rather than combining all perception modalities simultaneously. All templates are processed by the same diffusion transformer, output head, and flow matching objective, without modality specific learned heads, auxiliary losses, or manually balanced loss coefficients. By varying the perception task across training samples, this cross task formulation exposes the shared action generator to complementary geometric and semantic supervision. Experiments on held-out RLBench tasks demonstrate that XGenAct achieves the highest average closed-loop success among eight external policy baselines while retaining the ability to predict future RGB, depth, surface normals, and segmentation.
paragraphs.zh: 受 ActionImages Zhen 等人（2026）的启发——该方法将具有 7 个自由度的机器人动作表示为多视角 RGB 视频——我们将图像空间视为感知与控制共用的通用接口。这种表示方式尤其适用于结构化视觉信号，因为度量深度、表面法线和分割信息同样可以表示为可解码的 RGB 图像（Gabeur 等人，2026；Wang 等人，2026）。基于这一见解，我们提出了 XGenAct：一种增强几何信息的动作模型。该模型通过确定性编解码器将 RGB 观测数据、度量深度、表面法线、功能角色分割以及 7 个自由度的机器人动作统一表示为 RGB 视频。每一路信号都由相同的冻结视频 VAE 编码至共享的潜在空间。在训练过程中，每个样本都会选择一个感知动作模板，将某一感知通道与动作通道配对，而非同时结合所有感知模态。所有模板均通过相同的扩散变换器、输出头和流匹配目标进行处理，无需使用模态特定的可学习头、辅助损失或手动平衡的损失系数。通过在训练样本中变化感知任务，这种跨任务设计使共享的动作生成器能够接受互补的几何与语义监督。在预留的 RLBench 任务上进行的实验表明，XGenAct 在八种外部策略基线模型中实现了最高的平均闭环成功率，同时仍具备预测未来 RGB、深度、表面法线和分割信息的能力。

While most WAMs predict RGB futures, recent methods introduce geometric or semantic supervision. PAD ( Guo et al., 2024 ) extends joint image and action denoising to depth using separate modality encoders and decoders. RynnWorld-4D ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) generates RGB, depth, and optical flow using a three branch architecture, then predicts actions with a downstream inverse dynamics head. These methods demonstrate the value of structured future supervision, but rely on modality specific components, objectives, or action modules.

sents.zh: GeoSem-WAM（Ma et al., 2026）、DreamWAM（Yuan et al., 2026a）、WAM4D（Li et al., 2026）和X-WAM（Guo et al., 2026）通过辅助分支、残差模块或仅用于训练的读出层来融入几何信息。

sents.en: RynnWorld-4D ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) generates RGB, depth, and optical flow using a three branch architecture, then predicts actions with a downstream inverse dynamics head.
sents.zh: RynnWorld-4D（Zhao et al., 2026）使用三分支架构生成RGB图像、深度图和光流，然后通过下游的反动力学头预测动作。

sents.en: These methods demonstrate the value of structured future supervision, but rely on modality specific components, objectives, or action modules.
sents.zh: 这些方法展示了结构化未来监督的价值，但依赖于模态特定的组件、目标或动作模块。

paragraphs.en: SA-WAM ( Lopetegui Gonzalez et al., 2026 ) is closest to our representation. It encodes RGB and metric depth with the same frozen video tokenizer and jointly denoises them with actions in one latent sequence. However, actions occupy dedicated latent positions, and the model uses a fixed RGB, depth, and action layout. In contrast, XGenAct represents both structured perception and action as video streams and samples multiple perception action templates within one shared generative model.
paragraphs.zh: SA-WAM（Lopetegui Gonzalez 等人，2026）与我们的表示方式最为接近。 它使用相同的冻结视频分词器对 RGB 和度量深度进行编码，并通过动作在单个潜在序列中联合去噪。 然而，动作占据了专用的潜在位置，并且该模型使用了固定的 RGB、深度和动作布局。 相比之下，XGenAct 将结构化感知和行动都表示为视频流，并在一个共享的生成模型内采样多个感知-行动模板。

paragraphs.en: A complementary line of work formulates visual understanding through image or video generation. Painter ( Wang et al., 2023 ) and DICEPTION ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) express multiple perception tasks in a common visual space. Vision Banana ( Gabeur et al., 2026 ) and GenCeption ( Wang et al., 2026 ) generate depth, segmentation, surface normals, and correspondence from task prompts. SUV ( Yuan et al., 2026b ) applies a similar formulation to driving, but retains a separate action expert. These methods establish generation as a common interface for perception, but do not examine whether a mixture of structured perception tasks can improve a robot action generator expressed in the same output space.
paragraphs.zh: 另一条互补的研究路线通过生成图像或视频来实现视觉理解。 Painter（Wang 等人，2023）和 DICEPTION（Zhao 等人，2025）将多种感知任务表达在统一的视觉空间中。 Vision Banana（Gabeur 等人，2026）和 GenCeption（Wang 等人，2026）根据任务提示生成深度、分割图、表面法线和对应关系。 SUV（Yuan 等人，2026b）将类似的框架应用于驾驶任务，但保留了独立的动作专家模块。 这些方法确立了生成作为感知任务的通用接口，但并未检验混合结构化感知任务是否能夠提升在相同输出空间中表达的机器人动作生成器。

paragraphs.en: RT-Trajectory ( Gu et al., 2023 ) and TraceVLA ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) augment observations with visual motion cues but still predict action tokens. PIVOT ( Nasiriany et al., 2024 ) visualizes candidate actions for a vision language model to select. Action Images ( Zhen et al., 2026 ) instead represents a 7-DoF end effector pose as multiview RGB canvases generated by a video model. XGenAct extends this image space beyond RGB observations and actions by incorporating metric depth, surface normals, and functional role segmentation. This connects perception as generation with action as generation, allowing multiple geometric and semantic tasks to supervise one action generator without modality specific heads or auxiliary losses.
paragraphs.zh: RT-Trajectory（Gu 等人，2023）和 TraceVLA（Zheng 等人，2025）通过视觉运动线索增强观察信息，但仍需预测动作标记。 PIVOT（Nasiriany 等人，2024）将候选动作可视化，供视觉语言模型进行选择。 Action Images（Zhen 等人，2026）则将 7-DoF 末端执行器的姿态表示为由视频模型生成的多视角 RGB 画布。 XGenAct 通过融合度量深度、表面法线和功能角色分割，将这一图像空间扩展到了 RGB 观察和动作之外。 这实现了感知作为生成与动作作为生成之间的连接，使得多个几何和语义任务能够共同监督一个动作生成器，而无需模态特定的头或辅助损失。

paragraphs.en: We build XGenAct on the Action Images formulation ( Zhen et al., 2026 ) using a Wan2.2-TI2V-5B video diffusion backbone ( Wan Team, 2025 ) . Following Action Images, a 7-DoF robot action is projected into multiple camera views and rendered as an RGB video that can be decoded back into continuous control. We retain this action representation without modification. The video VAE remains frozen, and only the diffusion transformer is fine-tuned.

paragraphs.en: Our key idea is to extend this shared video space with geometry-related perception tasks. RGB observations, metric depth, surface normals, functional role segmentation, and robot actions are converted into RGB videos through deterministic codecs and encoded by the same frozen VAE. This places appearance, geometry, semantics, and control in a common latent space without introducing modality specific learned encoders or output heads.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的核心思路是，通过增加与几何相关的感知任务来扩展这个共享的视频空间。 RGB 观测数据、度量深度、表面法线、功能角色分割以及机器人动作，都通过确定性编码器转换为 RGB 视频，并由同一个冻结的 VAE 进行编码。 这样就能将外观、几何、语义和控制信息置于一个共同的潜在空间中，而无需引入特定模态的学习型编码器或输出头。

paragraphs.en: Raw metric depth has an unbounded and highly nonuniform value distribution, making direct grayscale encoding inefficient. We first compress depth values with a monotonic power transform and then map the resulting scalar values onto a continuous path through the RGB cube. At decoding time, generated colors are projected back onto this path before the scalar transform is inverted. This encoding distributes metric depth across an RGB path instead of a single grayscale axis. Full definitions and decoding rules are provided in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 原始度量深度具有无界且高度不均匀的值分布，这使得直接的灰度编码效率低下。 我们首先使用单调幂变换压缩深度值，然后将得到的标量值映射到 RGB 立方体内的连续路径上。 在解码时，生成的颜色会先被投影回这条路径，然后再对标量变换进行逆变换。 这种编码方式将度量深度分布在整个 RGB 路径上，而不是集中在单一的灰度轴上。 完整的定义和解码规则见附录 C。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate XGenAct on three questions: (i) how it compares with existing robot policies in closed loop evaluation (§ 4.2 ); (ii) whether generating structured perception during training improves the action policy, and how perception spaces affect the action performance(§ 4.3 ); and (iii) whether generating future geometry and semantics is more accurate than generating RGB and applying a frozen geometry perception model (§ 4.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在三个方面对 XGenAct 进行了评估：(i) 在闭环评估中，它与现有机器人策略相比表现如何（§ 4.2）；(ii) 在训练过程中生成结构化感知是否有助于提升动作策略，以及感知空间如何影响动作性能（§ 4.3）；以及 (iii) 生成未来的几何结构和语义信息，是否比生成 RGB 图像并应用一个固定的几何感知模型更为准确（§ 4.4）。

paragraphs.en: We name a training configuration by the perception templates in its menu: RGB trains on video+action only, and D , N and S add depth+action , normal+action and segmentation+action , respectively. The most inclusive menu, RGB+D+N+S , draws video+action with probability 0.4 0.4 and each perception template with probability 0.2 0.2 . Every model is fine-tuned from the released Action Images checkpoint ( Zhen et al., 2026 ) with the same backbone, frozen VAE, objective, conditioning-plan distribution and optimizer (effective batch 4, learning rate 5 × 10 − 7 5\times 10^{-7} ; Appendix E ), and is evaluated at step 4,000.

paragraphs.en: We train three groups of models, one per question. Two training sources are used: a self-generated RLBench tree ( James et al., 2020 ) of 16 tasks and 3,960 3{,}960 episodes at 512 2 512^{2} , and a ManiSkill3 tree ( Tao et al., 2025 ) of 7 tasks and 1,750 1{,}750 episodes (Appendix B ). (i) For the comparison with robot policies, XGenAct ( RGB+D+N+S ) and all baselines except the zero-shot MolmoAct are fine-tuned on the same RLBench tree. (ii) For the menu ablation, eight models, one per menu, are trained on RLBench and ManiSkill3 sampled at a 70 / 30 70/30 ratio. (iii) For the perception study, a separate set of menu models is trained on the same 70 / 30 70/30 mixture; an RLBench-only RGB+D+N+S model is included as unmatched context. All groups are evaluated on RLBench tasks absent from training; ManiSkill3 serves only as a training source.
paragraphs.zh: 我们训练了三组模型，每组对应一个问题。 使用了两种训练来源：一个自生成的 RLBench 树（James 等人，2020），包含 16 个任务和 3,960 个以 512² 分辨率运行的剧集；以及一个 ManiSkill3 树（Tao 等人，2025），包含 7 个任务和 1,750 个剧集（附录 B）。 (i) 在与机器人策略的对比实验中，XGenAct（RGB+D+N+S）以及除零样本 MolmoAct 之外的所有基线模型，都在相同的 RLBench 树上进行了微调。 (ii) 在菜单消融实验中，为每个菜单训练了一个模型，共八个模型，这些模型均在以 70/30 比例采样的 RLBench 和 ManiSkill3 数据集上进行训练。 (iii) 在感知研究中，一组独立的菜单模型在相同的 70/30 混合数据集上进行训练；同时加入了一个仅基于 RLBench 的 RGB+D+N+S 模型作为不匹配上下文对照。 所有模型组都在训练时未包含的 RLBench 任务上进行评估；ManiSkill3 仅用作训练来源。

paragraphs.en: Closed-loop control runs 20 trials per task with receding-horizon replanning under the IIII plan, capped at 1.5 × 1.5\times the demonstration length; success is RLBench’s task-success signal, and methods run in our rollout harness are paired by scene seed. Future perception is scored against the simulator state produced by each route’s own decoded actions: LPIPS for RGB ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) , absolute relative error for depth, mean cosine similarity for normals, and mIoU for segmentation.
paragraphs.zh: 闭环控制根据 IIII 计划，每任务运行 20 次试验，并采用滚动时域重新规划，其上限为演示长度的 1.5 × 1.5\times；成功由 RLBench 的任务成功信号判定，且在我们部署框架中运行的方法会按场景种子进行配对。 未来感知结果会与每条路线自身解码动作所生成的模拟器状态进行比较评分：RGB 使用 LPIPS（Zhang et al., 2018），深度使用绝对相对误差，法线使用平均余弦相似度，分割则使用 mIoU。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 compares the eight models of group (ii), which differ only in their training menu. Every menu with a perception stream improves on RGB , raising average success from 32.5 % 32.5\% to 52.5 52.5 – 61.25 % 61.25\% ; the best, RGB+N+S , gains 28.75 28.75 points. paragraphs.en: Every XGenAct model can produce a future perception map in two ways: generate it directly with the corresponding template (e.g. depth+action ), or generate future RGB with video+action and pass it to a frozen expert (Depth Anything V2 for depth, Lotus-G for normals, CLIPSeg for segmentation). paragraphs.en: We presented XGenAct , which expresses robot actions, future RGB video, metric depth, surface normals, and functional role segmentation through one video-generation interface. Deterministic codecs let these tasks share a frozen video VAE, diffusion transformer, output head, and objective, without modality-specific learned heads or auxiliary losses. On held-out RLBench tasks, structured perception improves closed-loop success over RGB-only training, while direct generation predicts future depth and segmentation more accurately than the evaluated RGB-to-expert pipelines. The best training menu remains task-dependent, motivating broader evaluations and adaptive task balancing.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 XGenAct，它通过单一的视频生成接口来表达机器人的动作、未来的 RGB 视频、度量深度、表面法线以及功能角色分割。 确定性编解码器使这些任务能够共享一个冻结的视频 VAE、扩散变换器、输出头和损失函数，而无需使用特定模态的学习头或辅助损失。 在预留的 RLBench 任务上，结构化感知相较于仅使用 RGB 的训练方法提升了闭环成功率，同时直接生成方法对未来深度和分割的预测也比所评估的 RGB-to-expert 流程更为准确。 最佳训练方案仍然因任务而异，这促使我们进行更广泛的评估和自适应的任务平衡。

paragraphs.en: We provide the information needed to independently reproduce our method and experiments throughout the paper and appendix. Section 3 and Appendix A specify the model, objective, and action representation; Appendices B – F document data construction and disjoint splits, deterministic modality codecs and admission checks, the complete training mixture, optimization hyperparameters, and camera conventions; and Appendices G and H define the evaluation and external-baseline protocols. We will publicly release the complete code for data generation and preprocessing, training, inference, closed-loop rollout, and evaluation, together with pinned environment specifications, launch commands, configuration files, task and split definitions, and the random seeds used in the reported experiments. We will also release the trained checkpoints for every reported XGenAct variant. paragraphs.en: The RLBench source contains 16 tasks, four camera views (front, overhead, left shoulder, and right shoulder), and 512 2 512^{2} observations recorded at 20 Hz, with per-frame metric depth, instance masks, and camera intrinsics and extrinsics written alongside every episode. Variation 0 is the only split used for training and holds 3,960 3{,}960 episodes. We targeted 250 seeds per task; light_bulb_in and place_shape_in_shape_sorter yielded 249 each, and sweep_to_dustpan yielded 212. Every episode is regenerated from its seed under Colosseum-style randomization ( Pumacay et al., 2024 ) of camera pose, table color, table texture, background texture, and light color. Object color, object texture, distractors, and object physics are deliberately not randomized: color is part of the instruction semantics (“close the red jar”). The randomization seed is derived from crc32(task|variation|seed) rather than from Python’s hash, so a tree is reproducible pixel-for-pixel across processes.
paragraphs.zh: RLBench 数据集包含 16 个任务、四种相机视角（正面、俯视、左肩和右肩），以及以 20 Hz 频率记录的 512×512² 个观测值；每一帧的深度指标、实例掩码、相机内参和外参都记录在每一集数据中。 变体 0 是训练阶段唯一使用的分片，共包含 3,960 集数据。 我们计划为每个任务设置 250 个种子；其中 light_bulb_in 和 place_shape_in_shape_sorter 各生成 249 集，而 sweep_to_dustpan 生成 212 集。 在 Colosseum 风格的随机化机制（Pumacay 等人，2024）下，每一集数据都会根据其种子重新生成，涉及相机姿态、桌子颜色、桌子纹理、背景纹理和灯光颜色的随机变化。 物体颜色、物体纹理、干扰物以及物体物理特性被刻意保留为固定值：颜色是指令语义的一部分（例如“关闭红色罐子”）。 随机化种子由 crc32(task|variation|seed) 计算得出，而非 Python 的哈希函数，因此同一棵树在不同进程中可实现像素级的完全可重复生成。

paragraphs.en: The ManiSkill3 source contains seven tasks and 1,750 1{,}750 training episodes. We produce it by replaying the official ManiSkill demonstrations ( Tao et al., 2025 ) frame by frame through set_state_dict and re-rendering them, rather than by collecting new trajectories. Each task contributes 250 episodes, and each episode is rendered from four cameras sampled on a sphere around the workspace center, at 512 2 512^{2} and 20 Hz, with one rendered frame per control step. Camera parameters are converted from the OpenCV convention to the RLBench convention of Appendix F , and each episode is admitted only if unprojecting and reprojecting its own rendered depth closes to under 0.51 0.51 px, if no mask pixel falls outside the segmentation vocabulary, and if the fraction of pixels outside the depth codec range stays under 3 % 3\% ; failures resample the cameras and, if needed, retry the episode. The byte-level layout is identical to the RLBench tree, so both sources are read by the same loader.
paragraphs.zh: ManiSkill3 数据源包含七个任务以及 1,750 个训练回合。 我们并非通过收集新的轨迹来生成该数据源，而是通过 frame by frame 地重播官方 ManiSkill 演示（Tao et al., 2025），利用 set_state_dict 并重新渲染它们来实现的。 每个任务贡献 250 个回合，每个回合均从围绕工作区中心的球面上采样的四个摄像头进行渲染，分辨率为 512²、帧率为 20 Hz，每个控制步生成一帧图像。 摄像头参数会从 OpenCV 的约定转换为附录 F 中 RLBench 的约定；只有当回合自身渲染的深度图经过反投影再重新投影后的误差小于 0.51 px、没有掩码像素落在分割词汇表之外，且深度编解码范围外的像素比例低于 3% 时，该回合才会被采纳；若出现失败，则会重新采样摄像头，并在必要时重试该回合。 其字节级布局与 RLBench 树结构完全一致，因此两个数据源都由同一个加载器读取。

(2026) , we evaluate the released MolmoAct-7B-D checkpoint zero-shot with the reasoning prompt from its model card and adapt its output to our controller as follows. MolmoAct draws a 2D end-effector trace on its primary input image, so each replan queries it twice, once with each view as the primary image. The two traces are resampled by arc length to 16 corresponding points, triangulated with the true camera matrices, and anchored to the current end-effector position. Orientation is held at its current value; the gripper command is the mean of the two predicted gripper values, thresholded at 0.5. All 16 waypoints are executed before replanning.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 Zhen 等人（2026）的研究，我们使用其模型卡中的推理提示，对已发布的 MolmoAct-7B-D 检查点进行了零样本评估，并按照以下方式将其输出适配到我们的控制器中。MolmoAct 会在其主要输入图像上绘制一个二维末端执行器轨迹，因此每次重新规划都会对其执行两次查询，分别以两种视角作为主图像。这两个轨迹会按弧长重采样为 16 个对应点，通过真实的相机矩阵进行三角测量，并锚定到当前的末端执行器位置。姿态则保持其当前值；夹爪指令为两个预测夹爪值的平均值，并以 0.5 作为阈值。所有 16 个路径点都会在重新规划前执行完毕。

paragraphs.en: PAD-Depth starts from the released Bridge-pretrained DiT-XL/2 (681M parameters). It uses the frozen SD VAE and CLIP text encoder and is fine-tuned on the front view at 256 2 256^{2} together with metric depth and the front camera parameters. It predicts k = 3 k=3 future frames and poses spaced 16 control steps apart, at global batch size 256 and learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} . We evaluate the step- 2,560 2{,}560 checkpoint, which has seen 655,360 655{,}360 samples, the same exposure as the 20,500 × 32 20{,}500\times 32 budget above. We fixed three issues in the released training code. The depth loader referenced an undefined attribute. The action loss was disabled for the first 50,000 50{,}000 steps; we enable it from step 0 with weight 1. The first future target was the current frame; we shift targets forward by one stride. Sampling uses 75 DDIM steps, as in the paper. Following the paper, only the first predicted pose is executed; it is linearly interpolated (orientation by slerp) into 16 waypoints to match the step budget of other policies.
paragraphs.zh: PAD-Depth 基于已发布的 Bridge-pretrained DiT-XL/2（6.81 亿个参数）启动。 它使用冻结的 SD VAE 和 CLIP 文本编码器，并在 256×256 的前视图上，结合度量深度和前摄像头参数进行微调。 它预测 k = 3 个未来帧和姿态，这些帧和姿态间隔 16 个控制步长，全局批量大小为 256，学习率为 10⁻⁴。 我们评估了第 2,560 步的检查点，该检查点已处理 655,360 个样本，与上述 20,500×32 的预算具有相同的曝光量。 我们修复了已发布训练代码中的三个问题。 深度加载器引用了一个未定义的属性。 在最初的 50,000 步中，动作损失被禁用；我们从第 0 步开始启用它，权重为 1。 第一个未来目标是当前帧；我们将目标向前移动一个步长。 采样使用 75 个 DDIM 步长，与论文中一致。 遵循论文的做法，仅执行第一个预测的姿姿态；该姿态通过线性插值（方向使用 slerp）生成 16 个途经点，以匹配其他策略的步长预算。

It observes the front and overhead views at 128 2 128^{2} over two frames, together with a 42-dimensional state: a 10-dimensional pose (position, 6D rotation, gripper) and 16 camera values per view. It predicts 16 actions and executes 8.
paragraphs.zh: UWM 从已发布的 DROID 预训练检查点开始，以批量大小 36 和学习率 10^{-4}，使用 delta 动作进行 4,600 步微调。 它在两个帧中观察 128×128 的前视和俯视图像，同时获取一个 42 维状态：10 维姿态（位置、6D 旋转、夹爪）以及每个视图的 16 个摄像头值。 它预测 16 个动作并执行其中 8 个。

paragraphs.en: VLA-JEPA starts from the released DROID-pretrained checkpoint ( VLA-JEPA-Pretrain ) and is fine-tuned with its LeRobot training code. Our actions are 10-dimensional poses and our state is the 42-dimensional vector used for UWM, whereas the pretrained model uses 7- or 8-dimensional ones, so the action encoder, action decoder and state encoder are re-initialized; all other weights, including the language backbone, are fine-tuned. The latent world-model objective stays enabled with its default weight of 0.1. The front and overhead views, at 224 2 224^{2} , fill the two exterior-camera slots of the pretrained model. States are normalized by mean and standard deviation and actions by their range, with statistics computed on our training tree. We train with AdamW (learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , β = ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) \beta=(0.9,0.95) , gradient clipping at 1.0) under a cosine schedule with 5,000 warmup steps, in bf16, at an effective batch size of 32, and evaluate the step- 2,000 2{,}000 checkpoint. The policy predicts 7 absolute poses and executes the first 4 before replanning.
paragraphs.zh: VLA-JEPA 从已发布的 DROID 预训练检查点（VLA-JEPA-Pretrain）开始，并使用其 LeRobot 训练代码进行微调。 我们的动作是 10 维姿态，状态是用于 UWM 的 42 维向量，而预训练模型使用的是 7 维或 8 维向量，因此动作编码器、动作解码器和状态编码器会被重新初始化；所有其他权重（包括语言主干网络）都会进行微调。 潜在世界模型的目标函数保持启用，其默认权重为 0.1。 正面和俯视视图的尺寸为 224²，占据了预训练模型中两个外部摄像头的槽位。 状态通过均值和标准差进行归一化，动作则通过其范围进行归一化，相关统计量基于我们的训练树计算得出。 我们使用 AdamW（学习率 10⁻⁴，β=(0.9, 0.95)，梯度裁剪值为 1.0）进行训练，采用余弦调度策略，包含 5,000 个预热步数，以 bf16 格式运行，有效批量大小为 32，并对第 2,000 步的检查点进行评估。 策略会预测 7 个绝对姿态，并在重新规划前执行其中前 4 个。

paragraphs.en: During a closed-loop rollout, every replanning step generates a chunk of future RGB and action images, the action images are decoded to poses, and the robot executes them. The dumps of Appendix I record, for each executed step k k , which frame of which generated chunk it came from and what the simulator rendered after executing it, so the two can be compared frame by frame.
